title: Events differ by at most the total variation distance
statement:
Let $\mu$ and $
u$ be probability measures on a measurable space $\Omega$. Then for every measurable set $S \subseteq \Omega$,
\[
  \abs{\mu(S) - 
u(S)} \le \mathrm{TV}(\mu,
u),
\]
where $\mathrm{TV}(\mu,
u) = 	frac{1}{2}
orm{\mu - 
u}_{\mathrm{TV}}$ is the total variation distance between $\mu$ and $
u$.
